issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 1,784,729 + Funds held by county treasurer 133,139; Restricted assets - Cash and cash equivalents 2,576,234 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: Computed sum (marked computed, arithmetic correct) leaves out the restricted cash 2,576,234 printed in the same column; whether restricted cash belongs in ending_cash is a judgment call (with it: 4,494,102). Also, the 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is never derived, and this value is a sum of two printed lines.
Category comes from the fund name, not the row label (marked computed). The fund-name rule in the extractor covers tax receipts only, so applying it to an 'Other revenue' row is an assumption.

issues.on_page: Utilities 320,656 (proprietary operating expenses by cost type)
issues.issue: A cost-type row (power/gas/phone bills of the utility funds) has the category 'utilities', which is also the name of the utility function category. A distinct cost-type name (e.g. 'Utilities (power, gas, phone)') may be intended.

issues.on_page: Public works 379,327 (printed separately from Streets 1,877,463; Statement of Activities also lists Public works separately)
issues.issue: Public works is put in streets/highways. This is defensible but not certain; the same applies to detail[5] 'Public works - Other' 366,468 (p14) and detail[34] Business Improvement District 'Public works' 32,218 (p20).
